ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Turn off notifications for an hour and notice the calm that follows.
